name: french-daily
description: French Daily — a mobile-first PWA for daily French vocabulary, conjugation and sentence practice with spaced repetition.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @french-daily/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @fd/auth-broker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/learning-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/french-data/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp-server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/auth-broker/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
